title: KAMRUI GK3PLUS Mini PC W-11 Pro, Intel N3350 8GB RAM 256GB SSD
writeup: This KAMRUI GK3PLUS is a basic Windows 11 Pro mini PC for reception desks, signage, kiosks or light office use. The maker lists an Intel Celeron N3350 (2 cores), 8GB soldered RAM, a 256GB M.2 SSD plus a free 2.5-inch SATA bay, two HDMI 1.4 ports and VGA for three 1080p60 screens. It is the Prime price, $189.99. The chip is a 2016 design with a PassMark multi-thread score near 1,115, the RAM cannot be upgraded, and there is no USB-C, so it suits only very light work.
